sections.indications_and_usage: USE DRIES UP ACNE PIMPLES, HELPS PREVENT NEW PIMPLES
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS shake very well before using clean the skin thoroughly before applying this product cover the entire affected area with a thin layer one to three times daily because excessive drying of the skin may occur, start with one application daily, then gradually increase to two or three times daily if needed or as directed by a doctor if bothersome dryness or peeling occurs, reduce application to once a day or every other day
